name: almaed-whatsapp-engine
description: Paced WhatsApp outreach for AlmaED via gowa, with reply handling and a local dashboard.

scripts.fetch-gowa: curl -fsSL https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/releases/download/v9.5.0/whatsapp_9.5.0_linux_amd64.zip -o /tmp/gowa.zip && (unzip -o -q /tmp/gowa.zip linux-amd64 -d gowa || python3 -m zipfile -e /tmp/gowa.zip gowa)
